cond_0001.intro: As the Laboratory Technician, you will follow best available practices and procedures of a Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure maximum yield and quality, while supporting the policies, goals and objectives of [Company name masked]. In this position, you will normally be responsible for the day to day testing and quality control procedures as identified by the Lab Manager. You will report directly to Quality Control (QC) Lab Manager.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Include but are not limited to:
Assists in maintaining the Quality Management system (QMS).
Monitors use and inventories of laboratory chemicals and supplies.
Operates, maintains, troubleshoots, and calibrates laboratory equipment.
Performs sample collection, preparation, and analysis per prescribed procedures.
Collects and sends samples to outside laboratories for analytical testing.
Properly documents all testing and calibration results within the company's data management system.
Promptly communicates abnormal results as applicable.
Prepares reports and analyzes data as applicable.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested by management.
Maintains safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
Complies with all regulations related to QA/QC laboratories at all times.
Completes all required safety training and helps champion safety compliance within the facility.
Follows programs and procedures required to ensure laboratory cleanliness and safety.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology). In lieu of a Bachelor's degree, an Associates degree in a scientific field with a minimum of 3 years of laboratory experience will be considered.
Experience with automated laboratory equipment (HPLC, GC, NIR, IC).
Proficiency in office computer software (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Must be able to complete Quality Process Analyst Certification (CQPA) Test Completion with a score of 80% or higher within one year of start date.
Valid driver's license.
Preferred Requirements:
Working knowledge with data analysis software: Multiquant, MassHunter, ChemStation, Lab Solutions.
Familiarity with Federal Drug and Administration (FDA) guidelines and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements.
Work Environment/Physical Demands:
The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 lbs. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to work near mechanical parts, dusty conditions, high noise environments, outside weather in all conditions and process chemicals.
All potential employees of [Company name masked] will be required to successfully pass a pre-employment drug screening and background check prior to employment.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Other duties may be assigned.

cond_0067.intro: As the Laboratory Technician, you will follow best available practices and procedures of a Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure maximum yield and quality, while supporting the policies, goals and objectives of [Company name masked]. In this position, you will normally be responsible for the day to day testing and quality control procedures as identified by the Lab Manager. You will report directly to Quality Control (QC) Lab Manager. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of laboratory testing and quality control procedures.
cond_0067.responsibilities:
Include but are not limited to:
Assists in maintaining the Quality Management system (QMS).
Monitors use and inventories of laboratory chemicals and supplies.
Operates, maintains, troubleshoots, and calibrates laboratory equipment.
Performs sample collection, preparation, and analysis per prescribed procedures.
Collects and sends samples to outside laboratories for analytical testing.
Properly documents all testing and calibration results within the company's data management system.
Promptly communicates abnormal results as applicable.
Prepares reports and analyzes data as applicable.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested by management.
Maintains safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
Complies with all regulations related to QA/QC laboratories at all times.
Completes all required safety training and helps champion safety compliance within the facility.
Follows programs and procedures required to ensure laboratory cleanliness and safety.
cond_0067.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology). In lieu of a Bachelor's degree, an Associates degree in a scientific field with a minimum of 3 years of laboratory experience will be considered.
Working knowledge with data analysis software: Multiquant, MassHunter, ChemStation, Lab Solutions.
Experience with automated laboratory equipment (HPLC, GC, NIR, IC).
To perform this job successfully, an individual must have expertise and proficiency in office computer software (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Must be able to complete Quality Process Analyst Certification (CQPA) Test Completion with a score of 80% or higher within one year of start date.
Familiarity with Federal Drug and Administration (FDA) guidelines and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements.
Valid driver's license required.
The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 lbs. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to work near mechanical parts, dusty conditions, high noise environments, outside weather in all conditions and process chemicals.

In this position, you will normally be responsible for the day to day testing and quality control procedures as identified by the Lab Manager. You will report directly to Quality Control (QC) Lab Manager. Most people become stronger in lab work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0221.responsibilities:
Include but are not limited to:
Assists in maintaining the Quality Management system (QMS).
Monitors use and inventories of laboratory chemicals and supplies.
Operates, maintains, troubleshoots, and calibrates laboratory equipment.
Performs sample collection, preparation, and analysis per prescribed procedures.
Collects and sends samples to outside laboratories for analytical testing.
Properly documents all testing and calibration results within the company's data management system.
Promptly communicates abnormal results as applicable.
Prepares reports and analyzes data as applicable.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested by management.
Maintains safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
Complies with all regulations related to QA/QC laboratories at all times.
Completes all required safety training and helps champion safety compliance within the facility.
Follows programs and procedures required to ensure laboratory cleanliness and safety.
cond_0221.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology). In lieu of a Bachelor's degree, an Associates degree in a scientific field with a minimum of 3 years of laboratory experience will be considered.
Experience with automated laboratory equipment (HPLC, GC, NIR, IC).
Proficiency in office computer software (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Must be able to complete Quality Process Analyst Certification (CQPA) Test Completion with a score of 80% or higher within one year of start date.
Valid driver's license.
Preferred Requirements
Working knowledge with data analysis software: Multiquant, MassHunter, ChemStation, Lab Solutions.
Familiarity with Federal Drug and Administration (FDA) guidelines and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements.
Work Environment/Physical Demands:
The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 lbs. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to work near mechanical parts, dusty conditions, high noise environments, outside weather in all conditions and process chemicals.
All potential employees of [Company name masked] will be required to successfully pass a pre-employment drug screening and background check prior to employment.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Other duties may be assigned.

In this position, you will follow best available practices and procedures of a Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure maximum yield and quality, while supporting the policies, goals, and objectives of [Company name masked]. You will be responsible for day-to-day testing and quality control procedures as identified by the Lab Manager, and will report directly to the Quality Control (QC) Lab Manager.
cond_0250.responsibilities:
Include but are not limited to:
Assists in maintaining the Quality Management System (QMS).
Monitors use and inventories of laboratory chemicals and supplies.
Operates, maintains, troubleshoots, and calibrates laboratory equipment.
Performs sample collection, preparation, and analysis per prescribed procedures.
Collects and sends samples to outside laboratories for analytical testing.
Documents all testing and calibration results within the company's data management system.
Reports abnormal results to the appropriate personnel as applicable.
Prepares reports and analyzes data as applicable.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested by management.
Maintains safety, health, and environmental policies and procedures.
Complies with all regulations related to QA/QC laboratories at all times.
Completes all required safety training and supports safety compliance within the facility.
Follows programs and procedures required to ensure laboratory cleanliness and safety.
cond_0250.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology). In lieu of a Bachelor's degree, an Associates degree in a scientific field with a minimum of 3 years of laboratory experience will be considered.
Working knowledge with data analysis software: Multiquant, MassHunter, ChemStation, Lab Solutions.
Experience with automated laboratory equipment (HPLC, GC, NIR, IC).
Proficiency in office computer software (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Must be able to complete Quality Process Analyst Certification (CQPA) Test Completion with a score of 80% or higher within one year of start date.
Familiarity with Federal Drug and Administration (FDA) guidelines and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements.
Valid driver's license required.
The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 lbs. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to work near mechanical parts, dusty conditions, high noise environments, outside weather in all conditions, and process chemicals.
All potential employees of [Company name masked] will be required to successfully pass a pre-employment drug screening and background check prior to employment.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Other duties may be assigned.

You will be responsible for day-to-day testing and quality control procedures as identified by the Lab Manager, and will report directly to the Quality Control (QC) Lab Manager.
cond_0268.responsibilities:
Include but are not limited to:
Assists in maintaining the Quality Management System (QMS).
Monitors use and inventories of laboratory chemicals and supplies.
Operates, maintains, troubleshoots, and calibrates laboratory equipment.
Performs sample collection, preparation, and analysis per prescribed procedures.
Collects and sends samples to outside laboratories for analytical testing.
Documents all testing and calibration results within the company's data management system.
Reports abnormal results to the appropriate personnel as applicable.
Prepares reports and analyzes data as applicable.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested by management.
Maintains safety, health, and environmental policies and procedures.
Complies with all regulations related to QA/QC laboratories at all times.
Completes all required safety training and supports safety compliance within the facility.
Follows programs and procedures required to ensure laboratory cleanliness and safety.
cond_0268.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology). In lieu of a Bachelor's degree, an Associates degree in a scientific field with a minimum of 3 years of laboratory experience will be considered.
Working knowledge with data analysis software: Multiquant, MassHunter, ChemStation, Lab Solutions.
Experience with automated laboratory equipment (HPLC, GC, NIR, IC).
Proficiency in office computer software (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Must be able to complete Quality Process Analyst Certification (CQPA) Test Completion with a score of 80% or higher within one year of start date.
Familiarity with Federal Drug and Administration (FDA) guidelines and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements.
Valid driver's license required.
The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 lbs. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to work near mechanical parts, dusty conditions, high noise environments, outside weather in all conditions, and process chemicals.
All potential employees of [Company name masked] will be required to successfully pass a pre-employment drug screening and background check prior to employment.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Other duties may be assigned.

cond_0328.intro: As the Laboratory Technician, you will follow best available practices and procedures of a Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure maximum yield and quality, while supporting the policies, goals and objectives of [Company name masked]. In this position, you will normally be responsible for the day to day testing and quality control procedures as identified by the Lab Manager. You will report directly to Quality Control (QC) Lab Manager. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of lab testing and quality control work.
cond_0328.responsibilities:
Include but are not limited to:
Assists in maintaining the Quality Management system (QMS).
Monitors use and inventories of laboratory chemicals and supplies.
Operates, maintains, troubleshoots, and calibrates laboratory equipment.
Performs sample collection, preparation, and analysis per prescribed procedures.
Collects and sends samples to outside laboratories for analytical testing.
Properly documents all testing and calibration results within the company's data management system.
Promptly communicates abnormal results as applicable.
Prepares reports and analyzes data as applicable.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested by management.
Maintains safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
Complies with all regulations related to QA/QC laboratories at all times.
Completes all required safety training and helps champion safety compliance within the facility.
Follows programs and procedures required to ensure laboratory cleanliness and safety.
cond_0328.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology). In lieu of a Bachelor's degree, an Associates degree in a scientific field with a minimum of 3 years of laboratory experience will be considered.
Experience with automated laboratory equipment (HPLC, GC, NIR, IC).
Expertise and proficiency in office computer software (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Must be able to complete Quality Process Analyst Certification (CQPA) Test Completion with a score of 80% or higher within one year of start date.
Valid driver's license.
Preferred Requirements
Working knowledge with data analysis software: Multiquant, MassHunter, ChemStation, Lab Solutions.
Familiarity with Federal Drug and Administration (FDA) guidelines and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements.

The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 lbs. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to work near mechanical parts, dusty conditions, high noise environments, outside weather in all conditions and process chemicals.

In this position, you will normally be responsible for the day to day testing and quality control procedures as identified by the Lab Manager. You will report directly to Quality Control (QC) Lab Manager. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with laboratory testing and quality control work.
cond_0338.responsibilities:
Include but are not limited to:
Assists in maintaining the Quality Management system (QMS).
Monitors use and inventories of laboratory chemicals and supplies.
Operates, maintains, troubleshoots, and calibrates laboratory equipment.
Performs sample collection, preparation, and analysis per prescribed procedures.
Collects and sends samples to outside laboratories for analytical testing.
Properly documents all testing and calibration results within the company's data management system.
Promptly communicates abnormal results as applicable.
Prepares reports and analyzes data as applicable.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested by management.
Maintains safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
Complies with all regulations related to QA/QC laboratories at all times.
Completes all required safety training and helps champion safety compliance within the facility.
Follows programs and procedures required to ensure laboratory cleanliness and safety.
cond_0338.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology). In lieu of a Bachelor's degree, an Associates degree in a scientific field with a minimum of 3 years of laboratory experience will be considered.

Experience with automated laboratory equipment (HPLC, GC, NIR, IC).

In this role, you will follow best available practices and procedures of a Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure maximum yield and quality, while supporting the policies, goals, and objectives of [Company name masked]. You will regularly handle day-to-day testing and quality control procedures as identified by the Lab Manager, and report directly to the QC Lab Manager. A good part of the role involves staying in contact with the Lab Manager and communicating results and updates on an ongoing basis.
cond_0510.responsibilities:
Include but are not limited to:
Assists in maintaining the Quality Management system (QMS).
Monitors use and inventories of laboratory chemicals and supplies.
Operates, maintains, troubleshoots, and calibrates laboratory equipment.
Performs sample collection, preparation, and analysis per prescribed procedures.
Collects and sends samples to outside laboratories for analytical testing.
Properly documents all testing and calibration results within the company's data management system.
Promptly communicates abnormal results to the relevant team members as applicable.
Prepares reports and analyzes data, sharing findings with management as applicable.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested by management.
Maintains safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
Complies with all regulations related to QA/QC laboratories at all times.
Completes all required safety training and actively helps champion safety compliance within the facility.
Follows programs and procedures required to ensure laboratory cleanliness and safety.
cond_0510.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology). In lieu of a Bachelor's degree, an Associates degree in a scientific field with a minimum of 3 years of laboratory experience will be considered.
Experience with automated laboratory equipment (HPLC, GC, NIR, IC).
Proficiency in office computer software (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Must be able to complete Quality Process Analyst Certification (CQPA) Test Completion with a score of 80% or higher within one year of start date.
Valid driver's license.
Preferred Requirements:
Working knowledge of data analysis software: Multiquant, MassHunter, ChemStation, Lab Solutions.
Familiarity with FDA guidelines and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements.
All potential employees of [Company name masked] will be required to successfully pass a pre-employment drug screening and background check prior to employment.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Other duties may be assigned.
Work Environment/Physical Demands:
The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 lbs. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to work near mechanical parts, dusty conditions, high noise environments, outside weather in all conditions and process chemicals.
cond_0510.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
